note: Pure A4 scan (595.32x841.92pt), 1654x2339px => 200.07 DPI; no text layer, so every number here is measured off pixels. Ordinary BODY page, verso: one single text column (x 0.2866-0.8936, i.e. 474-1478px) with a wide OUTER (left) margin that carries all the furniture - the brown/orange corner block with the leaf device, and the orange folio tab '20' with its short rule. That furniture sits OUTSIDE the text measure; because the page has only one column, every element is tagged column 'full' and its bbox is the authoritative position. body_text_size_px = 21.0 is cap/ascender-top to baseline, measured on three separate body lines (600-621, 639-660, 315-336), all identical; baseline-to-baseline leading is 39px (0.0167 of page height). SIZE_PT IS DELIBERATELY OMITTED on every element: with no text layer the typeface is unknown, so converting a measured 21px cap height into a font point size would require guessing the face's cap-height ratio - that is a guess, not a measurement. The scan resolution (200.07 DPI, 2.0008 px/pt) is given above so a consumer can convert any px figure itself. ACTIVITY BLOCK (n=2, 'Soak a few seeds in water...'): measured separately from the prose around it, 3 justified lines at y 393-498. It is set entirely in serif ITALIC at the SAME type size as body prose (size_rel 1.0, cap-to-baseline 21px) and carries NO tint, NO border and NO rule - fill is null. It is also set at normal leading with NO extra space above or below (its first baseline is exactly 39px after the previous paragraph's last baseline); the only thing that marks it off is the italic face and the first-line indent. I used role 'box' because that is what the element IS (an NCERT do-it-yourself activity callout) and it is the nearest allowed role, but a renderer must NOT draw a frame or panel for it. INDENT: no element on this page is block-indented from the column, so indent is 0.0 throughout. Separately, every paragraph except n=1 carries a FIRST-LINE indent of 51px = 0.031 of page width (first line starts at x=526 instead of 474); n=1 is flush because it is a paragraph continued from the previous page. n=2 and n=7 also carry that first-line indent. HEADING n=3 '1.4.3 Seed': cap-to-baseline 23px vs body 21px => size_rel 1.10; grey #6c6b6e sans, set BOLD (the allowed font list has no 'sans-bold', so 'sans' is reported and the weight is recorded here). Element 11 is the folio tab: the orange panel is x 0-257, y 1700-1788 and the white digits '20' sit inside it at [0.1070, 0.7366, 0.1306, 0.7486], cap height 28px => size_rel 1.33, set toward the panel's right end. Element 12 is NOT a full-width footer rule - it is a short orange rule (x 0-256) directly under the folio tab in the outer margin; 'footer_rule' is the nearest allowed role. Element 13 is the centred 'Reprint 2026-27' line at the page foot; 'running_header' is the only allowed role for a running line, so it is used here for a running FOOT. Element 14 is the diagonal '(c) NCERT not to be republished' watermark printed across the middle of the sheet - a very light grey overlay (not in the reading flow), reported as decorative_image with its measured extent; space_before is omitted for it because it has no position in the flow. SPACE_BEFORE is the gap from the bottom of the preceding element to the top of this one, as a fraction of page height, measured against the element listed before it; for the margin furniture (page_number, footer_rule) it is measured against the furniture above it in the same margin, which is why page_number shows a large 0.6366. The page is set SOLID: no figures, no tables, no blank bands - 47 text lines run from y=237 to y=1991 at uniform 39px leading and paragraph n=7 breaks mid-sentence onto the next page, so fill is 0.99. (Ink coverage within the text block is 70% of rows / 12.6% of pixels, but that measures glyph density, not how full the page is.) All seven A2 blocks were matched to a position with high confidence by reading order and line count: n=1 four lines, n=2 three lines, n=3 the heading, n=4 thirteen lines, n=5 eight lines, n=6 nine lines, n=7 six lines. No block is unmatched and no n is guessed. Colours sampled from flat interiors well away from edges and glyphs: header band #4a7435 (y 20-70, x 700-1400), corner block #725420, the orange strip inside the corner device #f7921e, folio tab and its rule #f8931f. Nothing on this page was unmeasurable apart from absolute point sizes, noted above.
